name: Cholesky Parameterisation for Gaussian Splats
definition: A method to parameterize the covariance matrix of a Gaussian splat using Cholesky decomposition to guarantee positive-definiteness by construction. It stores D(D+1)/2 elements per splat (6 for 3D).
summary: Cholesky Parameterisation represents Gaussian splat covariance via a lower triangular matrix to guarantee positive-definiteness, storing fewer parameters than quaternions while embedding geometric constraints directly into the optimization space.
